title.zh: 富强与创新 · 共同富裕 · 生态文明

clips.send: Kubuqi Desert. Today: Ordos, Inner Mongolia. A desert south of the great bend of the Yellow River. People have planted grass and trees here and built huge fields of solar panels on the sand.

clips.send: Five keys to development. Click each key. The textbook explains China’s rise with reform and opening up, and its next steps with innovation, education, sharing and green development. Each card gives the textbook’s key sentence. Open them all.

clips.send: Common mix-up: China’s textbook still calls China “the world’s largest developing country”: being second in total size is not the same as being rich per person.

clips.send: Beijing South Railway Station. A huge high-speed rail station opened in 2008; the Beijing–Shanghai and Beijing–Tianjin lines start here.

clips.send: Common mix-up: Do not mix up a “basic state policy” (基本国策, e.g. saving resources and protecting the environment) with a “strategy” (战略, e.g. innovation-driven development).

clips.send: Guangling County. A county in Datong, Shanxi. Shanxi was long known for coal; today wind turbines also turn on its hills.

clips.send: Saihanba. Today: Weichang County, Chengde, Hebei. Three generations of foresters turned sandy wasteland here into one of the largest planted forests in the world, which helps shield Beijing from sandstorms.

clips.send: Three sliders, three curves. A simplified model — not real data. Start with all three sliders at zero: growth looks great at first. Now drag the year to 20. Raise “green” and “innovation”: the first years are slower. Why? What happens later? Challenge: finish year 20 with the economy above 250, the environment above 60 and sharing above 60.

clips.send: 三个滑块，三条曲线。简化示意模型，不是真实数据。先把三个滑块都调到零：起初增长很快。然后把年份拖到第20年看看。调高“绿色”和“创新”：头几年变慢了。为什么？后来呢？挑战：让第20年的经济指数高于250、环境高于60、共享高于60。

clips.send: 发展的五把钥匙。点击每一把钥匙。教材用改革开放解释中国的发展成就，用创新、科教、共享、绿色说明下一步怎么走。每张卡片都有教材中的关键句，请全部点开。
